description: Defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Array', a PHP class for managing a sequential array of marker objects used in graph rendering, including methods for adding markers and drawing them on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Array
classes.description: A class for managing a sequence of markers for graph data points, allowing addition and sequential drawing of markers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a marker object to the internal marker array, and if it is an Image_Graph_Element, also calls the parent add method.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the current marker at specified (x, y) position on the canvas, cycling through the marker array.
